featured_reviews.name: Sunny Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Walked into the Lower Parel outlet of Burger King for lunch.
Had an average experience.
Tried Korean Chicken Burger. Liked the taste (was spicy and juicy) but the quantity was less (size of a Junior Burger, whereas it was priced 229 plus tax).
The service was okay. The lady server smiled and suggested the Korean burger. So will give her credit.
Otherwise it’s not that well maintained. Had trouble with flies. Took video of it. Although servers tried their best to ward off the flies with help of electric bat repellent.
When I entered there were hardly 3 - 4 other people in the restaurant. Maybe that’s why the AC was switched off. Thankfully other people entered and they switched on the AC. Else the first 15 min was quite dismal with me sweating while sitting inside.

featured_reviews.name: Ajinkya Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
I didn’t realize BK Lower Parel offered a VIP 'patience test' in a sauna today! I waited nearly 20 minutes for my meal while the AC was clearly on strike - in 40-degree heat, no less. I watched everyone who arrived after me get served while I slowly turned into a puddle; I was beginning to think I’d activated an invisibility cloak.

Turns out, my order just took a detour into the void. The fries were good though. And the manager did apologise once I reappeared in the physical realm. But it was clearly an off-day for the crew and the cooling system, and I’m sure they’ll have their radar (and the AC) fixed for my next visit!

featured_reviews.name: Roshani Batra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Opposite to Deepak Cinema, it is the 'Popular Sandwiches and more' as the name calls for in and around in the area. As the name suggests, the place is a hub for sandwich varieties. But sandwiches are not the only option that you'll get here, there are vast varieties in Pizzas, burgers, Maggi, Milkshakes and Juices too. Their menu also includes Pav Bhaji in cheese and without cheese, ice creams, Garlic Bread and sometimes Caramel Custard. Their Cheese Chocolate Sandwich has become quite popular amongst people who visit here quite often like me.
Prices are inexpensive and reasonable so you can divulge yourself into their quick hot serves within few minutes. Though the place has got limited seating arrangement, it serves perfectly delicious eateries in reasonable prices. I have been a regular eater over here and especially I have eaten 'Cheese Chocolate Sandwich' quite many a times. This review is collectively based on my more than two times eating experiences over here. My orders have been-
1) Cheese Chocolate Sandwich-
Price Rs 90/-
It tastes the best when eaten hot, so don't miss out on eating it right away when its served.
2) Pav Bhaji-
Price approx Rs 50-60
The finely chopped bhaji is very yummy and perfectly cooked. It tastes delicious with butter tossed little Pavs(buns)
3) Schezwan Maggi-
Price approx Rs 50-60
This is my second most favourite bite from here. It is spicy, delectable and tangy at the same time.

4) Veg Grilled Sandwich-
Price approx Rs 50-60
Since the place has been started with all its sandwich varieties, Veg grilled sandwich is a pride that the place can hold. It is yummy and delicious, no doubt at all.
5) Veggie Delight Pizza-
Price approx Rs 100
This pizza is full of veggie like tomato, capsicum and onion. It is served fresh and warm that subsequently gives the yummier taste.
Please don't go for ambience as the place is small with minimum seating but the savoury is worth a try! Its food is delightful and very affordable.

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Shankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Popular is a small sandwich joint in Lower Parel which has food offerings at a very nominal rate. Having tried their home delivery service, I found the service to be very prompt. Popular will definitely earn brownie points for quick delivery and neat packaging.

As for the food, here’s what I tried:

1. Veg Grilled Sandwich
This is your regular roadside grilled sandwich stuffed with chopped onions, tomatoes, capsicum and potatoes. There’s a mildly spiced coriander chutney which is spread in all the sandwiches. Since you can’t really go wrong with a sandwich like this, it’s worth a try.

2. Corn Cheese Grilled Sandwich
I had high expectations from this sandwich but found it to be very disappointing. Again, the coriander chutney spread was in it and it absolutely did not complement the boiled corn and capsicum. The cheese had hardened by the time it had reached so the taste was close to awful. Definitely would not recommend this.

3. Samosa Grilled Sandwich
As the name suggests, the sandwich is stuffed with a deconstructed samosa. The filling was slightly spicy and the sandwich had a very desi taste to it. It’s a heavy sandwich and definitely not for someone who doesn’t like to experiment with sandwiches.

4. Plain Garlic Bread
The garlic bread, which looked burnt in the first go didn’t falter on taste. I expected it to be disappointing but the garlic bread tasted surprisingly good. With chucks of garlic stuffed on top of a sesame bun and generous helpings of butter spread on top, this garlic bread is worth a try.

Overall, I wouldn’t rate the quality of food very high. Perhaps having the sandwiches freshly made at the restaurant would taste better but would not recommend their delivery service. The only highlights were the reasonable rates, prompt service and proper packaging of the food.

The place has a clean and cozy vibe, and the open kitchen lets you see your food being freshly prepared, which is always a plus!

I ordered the Crispy Paneer Roll for ₹150, and it was worth every penny. The roll was packed with fresh, soft paneer, crunchy veggies, and a generous layer of schezwan sauce that added just the right amount of heat. What stood out the most was the homely touch...it genuinely felt like it was made with care. Every bite was wholesome, flavorful, and comforting. The portion size was filling, and the quality was impressive.

So, if you're in Lower Parel and craving something delicious yet simple, this place is a must-visit.

Rating: 4.5/5
Price: ₹150 per roll

featured_reviews.name: Aatmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shreenathji’s is a vegetarian and Jain restaurant that offers a cozy, family-friendly ambiance. Their menu features a wide variety of dishes, including burgers, pizzas, sizzlers, salads, soups, pasta, starters, nachos, avocado bruschetta and fondue.

The Pav Bhaji Fondue was amazing—served hot with a creamy, tangy, and perfectly spiced taste that pairs beautifully with its accompaniments. The ‘Chinese water chestnut’ was something completely new yet definitely worth a try. The falafel was also well-prepared served alongside two condiments.

The Shrinathji Special Sizzler was great, offering bold and perfectly cooked flavors. Capsicum rings were nice, but personally, I didn’t prefer the crispy coating.

The classic sizzling brownie is the perfect way to end your meal🤤
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Aatmi,

Thank you so much for sharing your experience at Shreenathji's Lower Parel! 😊 We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our cozy, family-friendly ambiance and diverse menu.

We are delighted that you loved our Pav Bhaji Fondue and found it to be amazing. 😍 Our team takes great pride in preparing it with the perfect blend of creamy, tangy, and spiced flavors. We are glad that you enjoyed it with its accompaniments.

It's wonderful to know that you tried something new and enjoyed our 'Chinese water chestnut' dish. 💚 We strive to offer unique and delicious options for our customers to enjoy.

We also appreciate your kind words about our Shrinathji Special Sizzler. 😊 Our team always ensures that the sizzler is packed with bold and well-cooked flavors. We take note of your feedback about the crispy coating on the capsicum rings and will work on improving it.

Lastly, we are happy that you ended your meal on a sweet note with our classic sizzling brownie. 😋 It's definitely a crowd favorite and a perfect way to satisfy your sweet tooth.

Thank you once again for your lovely review! We can't wait to welcome you back for another memorable dining experience at Shreenathji's Lower Parel.

featured_reviews.name: Sandip Bhoir
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried this small roadside Chinese restaurant with very simple and average-looking setup, and honestly, I didn’t expect much. But the food completely surprised me.
The taste and quality were outstanding, easily better than many high-end or professional restaurants. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. You can really tell they focus more on food than appearance.
This place proves that great taste doesn’t need fancy interiors. Definitely worth visiting if you care about authentic and delicious food.

featured_reviews.name: Karan Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Was searching for a new street joint nr my office for chinese and randomly found this place. Prices are honestly very reasonable.

Tried their egg triple rice and it was actually quite good. Qty was proper, enough for one person nd Egg added was also more thn enough. Taste was nice, proper street-style Chinese with good flavor.

This place actually deserves more attention. If you’re around, do give it a try

Overall, a solid find for a quick and affordable meal. Def gonna go again

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Kaklotar
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you love sandwiches, Burgers, Pasta and continental preparations then you must try food from this delivery kitchen!

We ordered our lunch from this place, packaging was decent and food was delivered on time and it was still hot! We tried Burger, Pasta and Salad from this place and we liked the taste and quality of food that was delivered.

Fresh cottage cheese and veggies salad! Indeed great quality, fresh ingredients and loaded with exotic veggies and generous amount of cottage cheese. Well tossed veggies, power seeds and the perfect citrus dressing! Absolutely worth it.

Cheesy Veg Burger! Super soft buns, crispy patty, fresh veggies and loaded with cheese. This burger was absolutely lip smacking.

Veg pink pasta with cheese! Perfectly cooked penne pasta in creamy and cheesy pink sauce along with few fresh pieces of broccoli and topped with cheese slices.

Overall! They do have excellent options under their breakfast menu and their Burgers are definitely must try. Overall it was a decent experience.
